provenance.geometry_description: AMR_MASTER_Linear v80 (profile frame, Z10T mast, rigid drive suspension, 529 mm track), LiDAR Mount v3; includes laser and imu_link
provenance.mass_and_inertia: Retained from the v28 source URDF: 15 kg budget, approximate CoM/inertias; v80 not reweighed, so not a new measurement.
provenance.drive_gain: 5 Nm/(rad/s) is the prior PI-response surrogate, not a measured passive damping coefficient.
provenance.urdf_drive_damping: Provisional 0.1 Nm s/rad retained; now authored independently as PhysxJointAxisAPI viscous friction, separate from the velocity drive gain.
provenance.motor_envelope: Prior linear approximation from 24 V, 8.7 KV and 13 A; battery sag, thermal response and regenerative braking are not modeled.
provenance.caster: Contact friction retains prior tuning; unmeasured joint Coulomb torques disabled. Latest geometry retained.
provenance.joint_resistance: Legacy dimensionless PhysX coefficients are not torque measurements. Coulomb torque defaults to zero until measured; do not reinterpret the archived coefficients as Nm. URDF exports dynamic Coulomb torque; separate static torque is a PhysX extension.
provenance.wheel_contact: Rounded analytic cylinders and implicit compliant tire contacts reduce six-wheel contact chatter; dimensions, mass, inertia and actuator envelope retained. See reports/floor4_stability.json and reports/floor4_manual.json.

wheel_contact.calibration_status: Simulation stability parameters; not measured tire compliance. Rounded core preserves the source wheel outer radius and width.
